rules.criticality: critical if any contributing mapped attribute is critical; conditional criticality remains mandatory when applicable
rules.native: VM/disk/network/capacity/API data must be collected from source owners; Console must not override
rules.operator: Console accepts named references, objectives, datasets and explicit mappings; independent evidence separately verified
rules.optional: Only nonessential features may be omitted with independent E4 acceptance and native effect suppression
rules.decision: All nine source-target feature mappings are candidate translations, not supported or migration-ready decisions

features.label: API releases and entitlement
features.notes: Installed API families/versions and permissions must be observed and separately qualified.

features.label: VM identity and source scope
features.notes: Native IDs and source generation never copy to destination.

features.label: Power state and fencing
features.notes: Off/on values normalize but source fence must be rechecked at capture.

features.label: vCPU, RAM, CPU topology
features.notes: CPU counts and RAM can normalize; topology and guest support require qualification.

features.label: Host/cluster placement, capacity, quota
features.notes: Advertised capacity cannot establish exclusive resource reservations.

features.label: Firmware, Secure Boot, vTPM
features.notes: BIOS/EFI mapping alone does not transfer secure boot keys and TPM state.

features.label: Guest OS, agents, activation, drivers
features.notes: Guest identity metadata is not successful target guest boot.

features.label: GPU/PCI and removable devices
features.notes: Special hardware generally lacks generic live migration portability.

features.label: Complete root, local and attached disks
features.notes: All authoritative disks must be enumerated, including local/ephemeral and shared volumes.

features.label: Disk controllers and boot ordering
features.notes: Rebuild native bus and controller layout with guest boot validation.

features.label: Shared disks and multiwriter semantics
features.notes: Shared and multiattach disks require explicit fencing and special qualification.

features.label: Storage encryption and key custody
features.notes: Encryption handling and key custody must be independently verified.

features.label: Destination storage backend and capacity
features.notes: Datastore, container and Cinder volume type are not interchangeable storage types.

features.label: Capture, image conversion, import and VM creation
features.notes: Per platform and selected API version native effect tests are mandatory.

features.label: NIC count, MAC address and hardware
features.notes: MAC values normalize; guest adapter models and backed network semantics do not.

features.label: IPAM, DNS, segments and routing
features.notes: Network UUIDs do not translate across providers; operator chooses approved target intent.

features.label: Required connectivity and link state
features.notes: Required inbound and outbound application paths must be independently validated.

features.label: Firewall, microsegmentation and isolation
features.notes: Security policy requires equivalence and negative deny-path tests.

features.label: RBAC, tenants, licenses and credentials
features.notes: Installed entitlement, RBAC and isolation cannot be operator assertions alone.

features.label: Dataset coverage and mounts
features.notes: Application owner maps all datasets to real disks and validates complete capture.

features.label: Application consistency and quiescence
features.notes: Application-specific correctness requires owner protocols and native validation.

features.label: External service and application dependencies
features.notes: Identity, trust, backup, monitoring and app dependencies need owner mapping.

features.label: Maximum outage and data loss
features.notes: SLO/RTO/RPO targets are accepted by the application owner.

features.label: Post-migration application behavior
features.notes: VM power-on success is insufficient to prove application acceptance.

features.label: Final synchronization and writer fencing
features.notes: Ensure one authoritative writer, qualified delta and exact cutover.

features.label: Backup, restore and rollback
features.notes: Independent restore proof must cover both pre- and post-effect recovery.

features.label: Retention, cleanup and source retirement
features.notes: Retention and deletion authorization must be explicitly held.

features.label: Time, identity, logging, monitoring, backup
features.notes: Receiving owners validate service attachments and monitoring.

features.label: Nonessential labels, tags and conveniences
features.notes: Only proven nonfunctional optional omissions with E4 suppression are permitted.
